label: 3D AI Studio
description: 3D AI Studio API — text/image-to-3D, image generation, miniature flow, and mesh tools (Tripo, TRELLIS, Tencent, convert/repair/optimize). Optional import into a running Blender session.

settings.sections.title: 3D AI Studio
settings.sections.description: Paste your 3D AI Studio API key (from 3daistudio.com → Platform → API). Stored encrypted on this device. Powers studio3d_* MCP tools for text/image-to-3D, image gen, miniature flow, and mesh tools.

properties.label: API key
properties.description: Get a key at https://www.3daistudio.com/Platform/API#api-keys — required for studio3d_* tools. Use Test to verify the key.

steps.title: Paste your API key
steps.body: Create a key at 3daistudio.com → Platform → API, paste it here, then hit Test. Tools appear as studio3d_* once this plugin is enabled. Paid jobs always ask via a panel question (ducky_ask_user) before confirm_spend.

steps.title: Generate and import
steps.body: Ask the agent to generate a mesh (Tripo, TRELLIS, Tencent, miniature). Optional: open Blender with the MCP addon to land GLBs via studio3d_import_glb_to_blender. Modeling cleanup uses the separate Blender Store plugin.
